title: Territory Manager / Area Sales Manager
description:
Are you in for a big challenge, like contributing to the success of new global company? Epiroc is a leading global productivity partner to the mining, infrastructure, and natural resources industries. Epiroc stands for innovation, commitment, and collaboration, which is the speed to market & industry leadership; the passion to help customers succeed and a close partnership for deep understanding of the needs. We clearly aim to be our customers’ first choice.

* Responsible for Sales development, with major focus on corporate key accounts, existing clients, Private and Institutional sector of Underground and Opencast Metal Mining, Coal Mining, Railway Tunneling, Civil construction, Quarrying and Exploration Market.
* Achieving the set target for Equipment sales and consumables, across entire territory.
* Special attention towards Hydropower Projects and railway tunnelling projects to serve for underground equipment along with related equipment and consumables with aftermarket business for all existing customers and new customers.
* Grow and retain market share with existing customers and develop new customers / Key accounts. Get required visibility & market share in market, create good references.

* Initiate, develop and impliment sales plan and strategies for all the equipment as per the market demand.
* Lead from front to enter the new markets and counter competition.
* Strong commercial attitude and keeping receivables and liabilities under strict control.
* Gather competitor information, evaluate and analyze information about the trends, develop and maintain customer relationship and loyalty through visits, telephone calls and correspondence for eﬀective Key Account Management.
* Track performance of Equipment which are in operation (Epiroc and Competition). Mapping of business potential, product segmentation and creation of customer database. Chalk out short term and long-term action plan, review and chase on a regular basis
* Track the market shares for Epiroc Equipment (orders won-lost) within the territory.
* Consult and support Regional Manager in submitting proposal details such as pricing, type of product, application etc. Eﬀective communication/co-ordination with Product Marketing Team in Pune.
* Participate in seminars, exhibitions and contribute to other sales/marketing activities. High amount of Travel will be needed for this position.

  

**Qualification, Skills, and Experience:**

* Graduate in Mining / Mechanical Engineering.
* Post Graduate in Sales / Marketing Management would be an advantage.
* Around 8-10 years of proven performance in Capital Equipment Sales and/or product marketing within Mining and Construction Industry.
* Having experience in silimar segment would be an added advantage.

A self-propelled and is driven with proactive approach. Individual who is result oriented, team player, loves meeting customers and creating value. Person with Assertive approach with willingness to travel. A clear thinker with mature judgment, positive solution oriented, and believes that there is always a better way, is also a prerequisite for this assignment. One should have excellent communication and interpersonal relationship building Skill. A person with good collaboration and open-minded approach.

We at Epiroc accelerate this transformation, together with customers and business partners in more than 150 countries, by developing and providing innovative and safe equipment, digital solutions, and aftermarket support.

All new thinkers are welcome. We are looking for those who want to develop, grow, and dare to think new. About the Role

Apna Electrician is looking for an experienced **Business Development Executive** who can independently generate new business for our commercial, industrial and electrical contracting projects in Pune.

This is a **field sales \+ business development role**. We are looking for someone who already understands the Pune construction, electrical, MEP, interior or commercial project market and can build relationships without depending on a ready\-made company database.

What You Will Do

* Generate new leads independently through field visits, networking, referrals and market research.
* Identify upcoming commercial, industrial, office, retail, warehouse, factory, hotel, restaurant and building projects.
* Build relationships with architects, interior designers, builders, developers, contractors, PMCs, MEP consultants, facility managers and procurement teams.
* Find out which projects are in planning, tendering or execution stage.
* Generate RFQs, BOQs, site visits and quotation opportunities.
* Meet clients and project decision\-makers regularly.
* Visit project sites and understand electrical requirements.
* Coordinate with the estimation and project team for quotations.
* Follow up on quotations, negotiations and project closures.
* Develop a personal network of potential clients and project sources.
* Identify vendor registration and subcontracting opportunities.
* Maintain accurate lead and opportunity information in CRM.
* Generate repeat business and referrals from existing relationships.
* Share weekly market intelligence about upcoming projects and competitors.

Who We Are Looking For

* 3–5 years of experience in B2B sales/business development.
* Experience in **electrical contracting, MEP, construction, electrical products, building materials, interiors, industrial products or related industries** is preferred.
* Existing knowledge of the Pune commercial/construction market will be an advantage.
* Should be comfortable with extensive field visits.
* Must be capable of generating leads independently.
* Strong communication and negotiation skills.
* Should understand how commercial projects are acquired and executed.
* Two\-wheeler and valid driving licence preferred.
* Candidates who have previously sold to architects, contractors, builders, industries or corporate clients are preferred.

Important

**This is not a telecalling\-only job.**

We are specifically looking for a person who can go into the market, identify opportunities, meet decision\-makers and build a project pipeline for the company.

The candidate will be expected to **build their own prospect database** rather than waiting for leads from the company.

Performance

Performance will be evaluated primarily on:

* Qualified opportunities generated
* Meetings with decision\-makers
* Site visits
* RFQs/BOQs received
* Quotations generated
* Projects won
* Revenue generated
* Collection from closed projects
* Quality of CRM and market intelligence

**Salary can be negotiated for candidates with proven project\-sales experience and an existing relevant network.**

Pay: ₹21,000\.00 \- ₹30,000\.00 per month

Application Question(s):

* How many years of experience do you have in B2B sales/business development?
* Which industries have you sold products/services to?
* Have you personally generated B2B leads without receiving a ready\-made company database?
* Have you sold electrical contracting, MEP, construction, interior or building\-related services/products?
* How do you normally generate your own leads? ( Short Answer )

E. Communication \& Correspondence

* Draft professional emails, letters, notices and other official communications as instructed by the MD.
* Monitor and organize important correspondence.
* Coordinate communication between the MD and internal/external stakeholders.
* Maintain proper records of important communications.

F. Travel \& Logistics

* Coordinate domestic and international travel arrangements.
* Arrange tickets, hotels, transportation and travel itineraries.
* Coordinate meeting schedules during business travel.
* Maintain required travel\-related documents and records.

G. Confidentiality \& Documentation

* Maintain strict confidentiality of business, financial, employee and management information.
* Maintain important documents, reports, presentations and records systematically.
* Ensure sensitive information is shared only with authorized persons.
* Maintain proper document control and filing.

H. Management Follow\-up

* Maintain a tracker of important instructions given by the MD.
* Follow up with responsible persons until closure.
* Provide periodic updates on pending and completed activities.
* Highlight urgent issues requiring management attention.
* Ensure commitments made by departments are properly tracked.

I. Special Projects

* Support the MD in special assignments and business projects.
* Assist in collecting data and preparing reports for strategic initiatives.
* Coordinate cross\-functional projects as assigned.
* Conduct basic research and prepare summaries when required.

3\. Required Qualifications

* Graduate in any discipline.
* MBA / PG qualification will be an added advantage.
* Minimum **3–6 years of relevant experience** as Executive Assistant / Personal Assistant / Executive Secretary / Management Coordinator.

4\. Required Skills

* Excellent English communication – written and verbal.
* Good Marathi and Hindi communication skills.
* Strong coordination and follow\-up skills.
* Excellent organizational and time\-management abilities.
* Good knowledge of **MS Excel, Word and PowerPoint**.

* Good email drafting skills.
* Strong attention to detail.
* Ability to manage multiple priorities.
* Professional behaviour and maturity.
* High level of confidentiality and integrity.
* Ability to work independently with minimum supervision.

5\. Key Competencies

* Ownership \& Accountability
* Communication Skills
* Coordination \& Follow\-up
* Planning \& Organization
* Confidentiality
* Problem Solving
* Time Management
* Attention to Detail
* Professionalism
* Proactive Approach

6\. Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

* Timely completion of MD's assigned action points.
* Accuracy and timely submission of MIS reports.
* Timely preparation and circulation of MOM.
* Effective follow\-up and closure of pending activities.
* Proper calendar and meeting management.
* Accuracy of management information and reports.

The candidate should be proactive and should not wait for repeated instructions. The EA is expected to understand priorities, maintain proper follow\-up, keep the MD updated and ensure that important activities do not remain pending.

title: Purchase Executive
description:
**ABOUT ADVISTA TECHNOSOLUTIONS**

Advista Technosolutions Pvt. Ltd. is a **Pune\-based engineering services company** specialising in Industrial Instrumentation, Process Automation, and Turnkey Engineering Projects. Founded by an engineer with 20\+ years of domain expertise, we serve **100\+ clients across India and internationally** (UAE, Sri Lanka, Trinidad \& Tobago, Vietnam). We are MSME Udyam Registered, DPIIT Recognised Startup, and SC\-ST Hub Honoured by the Ministry of MSME.

We are a small, growing team at an exciting inflection point. The person joining in this role will work directly with the founder in a hands\-on environment where **initiative, accuracy, and ownership** are valued above all else.

**ROLE OVERVIEW**

This is a **dual\-function role** combining **Accounts \& Invoicing** with **Purchase \& Vendor Management.** The Executive will handle the complete order\-to\-invoice cycle on the accounts side, and the enquiry\-to\-dispatch cycle on the purchase side. Both functions operate simultaneously — this role is suited for a candidate who is **organised, fast\-paced, and comfortable with numbers, vendor communication, and documentation.**

*This is not a split role. Both functions are active daily. The ideal candidate treats both with equal ownership.*

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**PURCHASE \& VENDOR MANAGEMENT RESPONSIBILITIES**

* **Purchase Lead Register** on the same day of receipt without exception
* Check the internal rate/vendor database before floating any enquiry externally — mandatory first step for every new enquiry
* Float purchase enquiries to a minimum of 2 relevant vendors within 4 working hours if rates are unavailable in the database; ensure complete technical inputs are shared with vendors
* **24–48 hours** of receiving the enquiry — this is a non\-negotiable TAT
* **Weboo workflow** on the same day; keep Biziverse CRM in sync with order status
* **Purchase Orders (POs)** on the confirmed vendor within 1 working day of sales confirmation — correct specifications, price, delivery date, and payment terms
* Take structured weekly follow\-ups with vendors on all open POs until material is physically received at Advista — log every follow\-up in Weboo
* **Monday Order Status Updates** to the sales executive by 12:00 PM every Monday covering all open orders — real\-time, accurate information
* On material receipt: verify material against PO (quantity, specification, make); verify all associated documents (invoice, test report, calibration certificate) on the same day
* Ensure received material is inspected for damage and repacked securely before dispatch
* Arrange appropriate courier or transport for dispatch as per client requirement and urgency — within committed dispatch date and approved cost limits
* **Client Dispatch Intimation** on the same day of dispatch — email \+ WhatsApp with all three: Tax Invoice, material photographs, and courier docket/tracking number

**WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

**Required Qualifications \& Experience**

* B.Com / M.Com / BBA or equivalent graduate; commerce background preferred
* 1 – 3 years of hands\-on work experience in accounts and/or purchase in an engineering, manufacturing, or industrial trading company
* Biziverse ERP — training provided on joining; strong preference for candidates with any ERP/accounting software background; basic accounting concepts (journal entries, GST invoicing) are mandatory
* Microsoft Excel and Word — working proficiency; able to maintain registers, prepare statements, and format documents
* Basic working knowledge of GST (invoice format, HSN codes, GSTR\-1 data); TDS awareness is a plus
* Comfortable with vendor communication over email and WhatsApp in a professional manner
* Marathi and Hindi fluency required; basic written English for email communication

**Key Behavioural Attributes We Value**

* **Ownership mindset:** treats both accounts and purchase as their own department — does not wait to be reminded
* **Accuracy over speed:** checks before submitting; zero tolerance for invoice errors or wrong POs
* **Discipline with deadlines:** Monday updates go out on Monday; invoices go out on dispatch day; no exceptions
* **Proactive communication:** updates the manager on delays before the manager asks
* **Adaptability:** comfortable switching between accounts work in the morning and vendor follow\-ups in the afternoon — this is a multi\-task role
* **Growth orientation:** willing to learn new tools (Weboo, Biziverse CRM) and take on additional responsibilities as the company grows

**This Role Is NOT a Fit If You...**

* Have only done data entry with no ownership of the full accounts or purchase cycle
* Are looking for a work\-from\-home or flexible\-hours arrangement — this is a full\-time on\-site role
* Are not comfortable with direct vendor and client communication
* Expect a large team and dedicated IT support — we are a lean, growing company

Job Type: Full\-time

* **Night\-Shift Stamina \& Schedule Alignment:** Full\-time commitment to our international shift: 7:00 PM – 3:30 AM IST (Monday through Friday), structured to support European afternoon follow\-ups, US East Coast mornings, and US West Coast business hours.

title: Lead Sales Engineer-Automotive
description:
**SALES LEADER — INDIA**

Software \& IT Services · 12th Wonder · Pune

12th Wonder has 70 engineers, 100\+ customers, and 12 years of delivery capability across Indian enterprises. We have no sales function — zero pipeline, zero SDRs, zero outbound motion.

We're hiring a player\-coach to own India sales end\-to\-end: hunt deals, build the team, and create a repeatable engine that outlasts any single person.

**THE ROLE**

You'll build the India sales function from scratch. No inherited pipeline, no inbound engine, no SDR team. You bring the commercial capability; we bring the delivery machine behind it.

Year one splits roughly 70/30\. **70% is CXO selling** — prospecting strategic accounts, running discovery, shaping solutions with pre\-sales, presenting proposals, negotiating contracts, and closing. **30% is building the SDR motion** — hiring the first SDR around month two, defining outreach strategy, setting targets, and coaching. When the two collide, closing wins.

**You own the number and the playbook.** You define the ICP, choose the target industries, design the outbound motion, pick the CRM, and build the team around it. Strategy is not handed down. You're the first commercial hire in the seat, with a titled path to **Head of Sales — India within 18 months on plan**, and a seat in the weekly leadership meeting from week one.

**Your buyer:** India\-domiciled enterprises in three segments — automotive OEMs and Tier\-1 suppliers, testing and certification (TIC) labs, and enterprise engineering R\&D centres. Rupee\-denominated, relationship\-led, CXO\-level deals averaging \~₹20 lakh.

**WHAT YOU'LL HAVE BEHIND YOU**

This isn't a startup asking you to sell vapourware. You're selling a proven delivery capability to new buyers.

* 70\-person engineering team across full\-stack development, managed teams, and R\&D services
* 100\+ existing customers — referenceable proof that the delivery model works
* Pune delivery centre operational since 2019, with the Chakan–Talegaon automotive belt inside a morning's drive
* Budget for the CRM you choose in month one, plus data, tooling, and events
* Direct reporting line to the COO, with leadership access from day one

**RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Close business personally.** Prospect, discover, propose, negotiate, win, then grow accounts through cross\-sell and upsell.

**Build the pipeline machine.** Define target segments. Build account lists. Run outbound across LinkedIn, email, cold calls, referrals, events, and partnerships. Maintain CRM discipline. Forecast accurately. Keep pipeline coverage at 3x forward target.

**Build the SDR motion.** Hire the first SDR around month two. Set targets, define outreach, allocate accounts, coach on messaging and objection handling. As the team grows past five, we hire a dedicated SDR manager so you stay in front of customers.

**Shape the GTM strategy.** Identify high\-potential industries and partnerships. Develop buyer personas and industry propositions. Study competitors. Build a repeatable, measurable sales process the company can scale beyond you.

**MILESTONES**

***Exhibit 1: Year\-one delivery cadence***

**Timeframe**

**Expected Outcome**

**First 30 days**

ICP defined and signed off. Target account list built. CRM configured with a pipeline you'd defend in a board meeting.

**First 60 days**

First SDR hired, with activity targets and an outreach playbook they can run.

**First 90 days**

Outbound motion live across at least two channels. First qualified opportunities in stage.

**First 180 days**

First closed\-won deals on the board. Pipeline coverage at 3x forward target. A written sales playbook someone else could run.

**End of year one**

₹1 crore in closed revenue — roughly five deals at our average size — and a repeatable motion that doesn't depend on you personally.

**REQUIREMENTS**

* 5–8 years in B2B sales of software development and IT services to Indian enterprises
* Built pipeline from scratch — not just worked what marketing generated
* Comfortable selling to CXOs, CTOs, CIOs, engineering heads, and procurement
* Can defend a rate card and a delivery model, not just a relationship
* Thinks in conversion rates, pipeline coverage ratios, and forecast accuracy
* Has managed or coached SDRs and knows the difference between activity and output
* Wants a role where hitting target is the floor, not the ceiling

**Nice to have:** *An existing network in the Pune–Chakan–Talegaon automotive belt or TIC/testing sector; experience closing deals in the ₹15–30 lakh range; exposure to offshore and onsite delivery models.*

**COMPENSATION**

Cash role — fixed plus variable, no ESOP attached. We'd rather tell you that now than dangle paper you can't price.

***Exhibit 2: Compensation structure***

**FIXED**

**TARGET**

**VARIABLE AT PLAN**

**OTE AT PLAN**

**₹18–20L**

**₹1 crore**

**₹7\.5L**

**₹25–28L**

**Variable is a flat 7\.5% of closed revenue, uncapped.** The rate doesn't taper past target — close ₹1\.5 crore and the plan pays ₹11\.25L, no renegotiation. Variable pays pro\-rata from 70% of target, on revenue closed at or above floor margin.

**DETAILS**

***Exhibit 3: Role parameters***

**Location**

Pune. Remote (India) considered for exceptional candidates, with monthly onsite weeks.

**Buyer geography**

India\-domiciled enterprises

**Reports to**

Chief Operating Officer

**Year\-one target**

₹1 crore in closed revenue

\~₹20 lakh

**Travel**

\~30%, primarily metro India

**Start**

Immediate

**HOW HIRING WORKS**

Three conversations over about two weeks:

**1\. Screening call (30 min)** — your track record, and whether the buyer and motion match what you've done.

**2\. Working session (90 min)** — you walk us through your first 90 days in market; we send context in advance.\-Neerav

**3\. Leadership conversation (60 min)** — with the CEO: ownership, the number, and the terms.\-Ajay (CEO)

Decision within 5 working days of the last conversation, either way.

**INTERESTED?**

Send your CV and a short note to **HR@12thwonder.com** — three lines on the hardest pipeline you ever built from nothing is worth more to us than a cover letter.

*If you've read this far and your reaction is "finally, a role with real ownership" — let's talk.*

* *12th Wonder is an equal opportunity employer. We hire on evidence of capability and nothing else.*

Pay: From ₹1,800,000\.00 per year

title: Sr Spec Proposal Content Dsnr
description:
**About Data Axle:**



Data Axle Inc. has been an industry leader in data, marketing solutions, sales, and research for over 50 years in the USA. Data Axle now has an established strategic global centre of excellence in Pune. This centre delivers mission critical data services to its global customers powered by its proprietary cloud\-based technology platform and by leveraging proprietary business and consumer databases.


Data Axle India is recognized as a Great Place to Work! This prestigious designation is a testament to our collective efforts in fostering an exceptional workplace culture and creating an environment where every team member can thrive


**General Summary:**



The Proposal Content Designer plays a critical role in supporting the Commercial Sales Division by shaping and telling the story behind our most important pursuits. Engaging early alongside Proposal Managers, sales stakeholders, and peer content roles, this position helps develop the narrative through\-line and win themes, then owns the visual translation of that story — designing executive summaries, pitch decks, orals materials, infographics, and leave\-behinds that make complex solutions, ROI, and Data Axle differentiators immediately clear to client audiences. Depending on the pursuit, this role may shape the story largely independently or as one contributor on a collaborative pursuit team. This role ensures every client\-facing pursuit artifact is on\-brand, visually consistent, and positioned to differentiate Data Axle in competitive pursuits.


**Essential Job Functions: \***


* Engage early in the pursuit to shape the story, developing the through\-line, win themes, and differentiators that carry a response. Lead this work largely independently on some pursuits and contribute as one voice on a collaborative team with Proposal Managers, sales stakeholders, and peer content roles on others.


* Storyboard the narrative and visual approach before production begins, so structure and sequence are agreed across the pursuit team.


* Translate RFP responses, proposals, and solution content into visual narratives — executive summaries, pitch decks, orals materials, and leave\-behinds — from concept through final delivery.


* Design infographics, process diagrams, timelines, and data visualizations that make complex solutions and value propositions land quickly with client audiences.


* Own visual quality, brand compliance, and production accuracy across all pursuit artifacts; work within corporate design standards in partnership with Brand and Creative, and manage client submission requirements including page and character limits, mandated formatting, file specifications, and print requirements.


* Build and maintain a reusable library of templates, layouts, graphics, and design components; establish design standards and a simple intake process so routine responses do not start from zero.


* Essential functions are the basic job duties that an employee must be able to perform, with or without reasonable accommodation. The function is considered essential if the reason the position exists is to perform that function.


**Supportive Job Functions: \***


* Provide post\-submission debriefs on visual effectiveness and feed learnings back into the template and content library.


* Support broader marketing initiatives as necessary including go\-to\-market activity, training programs, corporate marketing programs and content development.


* Perform additional sales enablement tasks as required by leadership.


* These tasks do not meet the Americans with Disabilities Act definition of essential job functions and usually equal 5% or less of time spent. However, these tasks still constitute important performance aspects of the job.


Requirements:
**Knowledge, Skill, and Abilities:**


* Expert\-level PowerPoint and presentation design, with advanced proficiency in Adobe Creative Suite (InDesign, Illustrator, Photoshop).


* Strong information design instincts, with the ability to take dense written or technical content and identify the visual structure that makes it clear.


* Excellent visual storytelling ability and a keen eye for brand consistency, layout, and detail.


* Editorial judgment sufficient to edit and condense written content for visual formats without altering intent or accuracy.


* Ability to manage multiple, concurrent pursuits under compressed deadlines with shifting requirements, and the judgment to know when to escalate.


* Ability to operate at both ends of the autonomy range: carrying a pursuit story independently when needed, and integrating direction and critique as one contributor among peers when the pursuit calls for a team approach.


* Ability to work cross\-functionally and collaborate with diverse teams in a fast\-paced environment.


**Education, Experience, and Certification: \***


* Bachelor's Degree in graphic design, visual communications, or equivalent experience preferred.


* 5\-7\+ years designing complex, deadline\-driven presentations and documents; proposal, bid, pursuit, agency, or in\-house B2B marketing backgrounds preferred.


* Portfolio required, demonstrating visual storytelling applied to complex or technical subject matter.


* Experience working with enterprise sales teams in the marketing technology or data services industry preferred.


* Experience building and governing a design system, template library, or brand asset system.


* Experience innovating with AI to improve design workflow, production speed, and content quality.


* Minimum requirements needed to perform the job.


**Scope of Job:**


* No direct or indirect reports. Will work across multiple teams to ensure proposal success.


* No supervisory responsibility: General direction received from \[Director, Proposal Management / Revenue Enablement]. Exercises independent judgment on story and design direction, with latitude that varies by pursuit.


* Working conditions are good, with some travel for sales meetings or industry events, and a consistent workweek.


* Errors are not always detectible and may be serious and costly.


* Contact with others inside and outside the Company is regular and frequent.


* Some access to confidential company and client data.


**Disclaimer:**



Data Axle India follows a merit\-based employee recruitment practice with extensive screening steps. Data Axle India does not charge/accept any amount or security deposit from job seekers during the recruitment process.


Job Seekers are requested to be aware of unsolicited or fraudulent communication regarding a job offer or an interview call against payment of money, please stay alert. All Data Axle India jobs are published on the Careers page of its website and/or on its LinkedIn profile. Interested job seekers may access the same and apply directly.

title: Director of Customer Experience, Sell
description:
**Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)**  

**Permanent \- Full Time**

  

**About Us:**  

  

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.


Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.


Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.  

  

  

  

**About The Role:**

The Sell Director is one of the most senior leaders in the Customer Experience organisation, accountable for the full performance of the Sell domain and for outcomes that roll up to the overall CX organisation: CSAT, SLA performance and Cost of Support.


This role owns the operating model, people decisions, quality standards, KPI performance and transformation agenda for the Sell domain. A core part of the role is leading the domain Subject Matter Experts, who preserve tacit product knowledge and turn it into practical training, documented knowledge and AI\-ready content used by internal teams, the BPO, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis and AI\-enabled support.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Own CSAT, SLA and Cost of Support outcomes for the Sell domain, with clear reporting to CX Leadership.
* Own the operational KPIs that drive those outcomes: First Reply, Next Reply, First Contact Resolution, Reopen Rate and Abandoned Call performance.
* Own hiring, promotion, performance management and termination decisions across the domain, within company and HR policy.
* Ensure support quality is maintained through clear standards, coaching, knowledge use, escalation handling and customer communication.
* Lead the domain SMEs as a strategic knowledge capability: capture tacit product knowledge, convert it into training, documented guidance and AI\-usable content, and keep that knowledge current.
* Use SME insight to spot product knowledge gaps, support process issues, training needs and AI answer\-quality gaps, then drive fixes with Quality \& Training and Systems \& Analysis.
* Drive AI adoption, automation and self\-service that reduce unnecessary human touch and Cost of Support while maintaining or improving customer outcomes.
* Run the domain operating rhythm across performance review, KPI analysis, risk/action tracking, escalation management and continuous improvement.
* Partner with BPO Management, Quality \& Training, Systems \& Analysis, Product, Engineering and Commercial teams to remove blockers and improve execution.
* Provide concise, evidence\-based updates to the SVP of CX and CX Leadership, including risks, root causes, corrective actions and progress against commitments.

**SME, Knowledge and AI Accountability**

The Director is accountable for making SME knowledge operational: not only answering difficult questions, but improving the whole support model by raising capability, reducing repeat issues and making knowledge reusable across teams and AI.


* Prioritise SME work based on customer impact, ticket demand, product complexity, BPO readiness and AI adoption opportunities.
* Ensure SME outputs flow into training, knowledge articles, troubleshooting guides, QA calibration, macros, escalation logic and AI knowledge sources.
Create a simple governance rhythm for SME output, including knowledge gaps, training needs, AI content improvements and measurable impact on CSAT, SLA, FCR, reopens and cost. This may look like following the KCS standard, or other such framework.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Extensive leadership experience in customer experience, customer support, contact\-centre operations or comparable service delivery environments.
* Equivalent experience is valued where the individual has demonstrated ownership of large\-scale operational outcomes, multi\-level teams, financial performance, customer experience quality and specialist knowledge\-management capability.
* Proven ownership of CSAT, SLA, Cost of Support and related operational KPIs in a complex support environment.
* Strong operational command of First Reply, Next Reply, FCR, Reopen Rate, Abandoned Call and the drivers behind those measures.
* Experience leading managers, specialists and distributed support teams, including significant people\-decision accountability.
* Ability to convert deep product expertise into scalable training, knowledge, quality standards and AI\-ready support content through SMEs or similar specialist teams.
* Strong financial and productivity discipline, with the ability to connect workforce, process, tooling and AI adoption decisions to cost outcomes.
* High confidence using data to diagnose performance, explain root causes, make trade\-offs and drive action.
* Executive\-level communication skills, with concise reporting of performance, risk, decisions and corrective actions.

**Preferred but not required**

* Experience leading a product\-aligned support domain similar in scale or complexity to Sell.
* Experience in a global, matrixed CX organisation with centralised quality, systems, analytics, SME and BPO support functions.
Experience with Zendesk, CCaaS, workforce management, knowledge platforms, AI\-enabled support tooling or major cost\-to\-serve transformation.  
* 

  

**Working For Us:**  

  

At Cyncly, we call our team OneCyncly, a reflection of how we work together as one, united by our purpose: powering businesses that bring spaces to life. Our strength comes from our diversity of experiences, perspectives, and skills \- and we thrive when we work together with openness, trust, and respect.


Here, you’ll join a group of colleagues who take ownership, solve problems, and focus on making an impact. We embrace curiosity, welcome new ideas, and see mistakes as opportunities to learn. You’ll have the freedom to work flexibly and autonomously, supported by teammates and leaders who are committed to your growth.


We celebrate the different ways people contribute and encourage everyone \- from every background \- to bring their authentic self to work. Because when we collaborate, challenge each other, and share what we know, we build something better together.


If you want to work in a place where your ideas matter, your growth is valued, and your work shapes the spaces people live, work, and play in \- come join us.

title: Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience
description:
**Location: Pune, India (Hybrid)**  

**Permanent \- Full Time**

  

**About Us:**  

  

Cyncly is a global technology powerhouse with 2,400\+ employees and 70,000\+ customers across 100\+ countries. Cyncly transforms the way customizable products and spaces are imagined, designed, sold, managed and made. Our end\-to\-end software solutions connect professional designers, retailers and manufacturers to the world's largest repository of product content. Today, our business spans across the Kitchen \& Bath, Furniture, Window, Glass \& Door, and Flooring industries with operations in North \& South America, Europe, Asia Pacific and Africa.


Cyncly brings over 30 years of experience to deliver more value for our customers through an expanded portfolio of end\-to\-end solutions. Our global presence allows us to provide world\-class support and sales with a local touch, providing the best possible customer experience.


Cyncly is now embarking on an exciting journey as we continue to expand through strong organic growth and complementary acquisitions, backed by leading growth private equity firms specialised in technology.  

  

  

  

**About The Role:**

The Program Governance Manager – Customer Experience is a relationship and governance role, not a target\-carrying operations role. You own the mechanism that makes the partnership work: the reporting, cadence, coordination, and health of the relationship. The delivery targets themselves (service levels, quality and cost) sit with the operational leaders. Your job is to make sure the partner always knows what is expected and where they stand, and that Cyncly leaders always have an accurate, current picture of the performance outputs of the BPO. Leaders such as our CX Domain Directors, SVP CX, CCO, and wider executive members.


We work with a strategic outsourcing (BPO) partner to deliver customer support across multiple domains, product lines, and regions. This role is the single point of contact between Cyncly and that partner.


You will keep a clear, consistent, and trusted view of how the relationship is performing, so that everyone on both sides always knows where things stand. You will stand the partnership up through transition and go\-live and then run the ongoing relationship day to day.


The role is designed to expand as trust is earned: at the start, you stand up the mechanism, get reporting flowing, establish the governance cadence and make the transition land cleanly; as the relationship settles, you move from reactive to proactive by anticipating risks, championing change and building a genuine joint team; and in the mature relationship, you become a true partnership steward, keeping leadership sponsorship sharp and the relationship healthy and honest. The through\-line is a move from running the reporting to making the partnership succeed.  

  



**Main Responsibilities:**

* Act as the single point of contact for Cyncly's outsourcing partner across operational, reporting and relationship matters.
* Build and run the governance rhythm, including performance reporting, review meetings, quarterly business reviews, agendas, minutes, and action tracking.
* Produce clear, accurate performance reporting and maintain one consistent view of how the partnership is performing, creating a single trusted version rather than different stories across the business.
* Route and coordinate escalations to the right owners and drive them through to resolution.
* Coordinate capacity, workforce planning, and forecasting between partner and internal teams.
* Track risks, actions, issues and decisions, and surface emerging risks early.
* Lead Cyncly's side of the transition and go\-live, partnering closely with the provider's transition team, then carrying the relationship into a steady state.
Champion continuous improvement and a genuine one\-team relationship built on trust and honest communication rather than adversarial vendor management.  
* 

**Required Skills and Experience:**

**Experience**

* Typically 8 to 14 years of experience in customer experience, contact center or BPO delivery, including experience managing or governing an outsourced engagement from the client side.
* Equivalent experience is valued; formal project, programme or partnership\-management credentials are welcomed where they support the role, but are not the primary requirement.

* Strong operational command of First Reply, Next Reply, FCR, Reopen Rate, Abandoned Call and the drivers behind those measures.
* Experience leading managers, specialists and distributed support teams, including significant people\-decision accountability.
* Ability to convert deep product expertise into scalable training, knowledge, quality standards and AI\-ready support content through SMEs or similar specialist teams.
* Strong financial and productivity discipline, with the ability to connect workforce, process, tooling and AI adoption decisions to cost outcomes.
* High confidence using data to diagnose performance, explain root causes, make trade\-offs and drive action.
* Executive\-level communication skills, with concise reporting of performance, risk, decisions and corrective actions.

**Preferred but not required**

Experience with Zendesk, CCaaS, workforce management, knowledge platforms, AI\-enabled support tooling or major cost\-to\-serve transformation.

description:

This Position reports to:


Sales Manager **What we believe in**


At ABB, we are dedicated to addressing global challenges. Our core values: care, courage, curiosity, and collaboration \- combined with a focus on diversity, inclusion, and equal opportunities \- are key drivers in our aim to empower everyone to create sustainable solutions. That's our story. Make it your story.

**Your role and responsibilities:**


In this role, you will have the opportunity to be responsible for the sales of products/systems/services within a designated market/division, in line with the division strategy. Each day, you will meet both qualitative and quantitative sales targets to ensure sustainable order growth, revenues, profitability, market share, and customer satisfaction. You will also showcase your sales skills by identifying and developing new sales opportunities.


The work model for the role is: \#Li\-Onsite


The role will support for the ABB India Ltd for Electrification Smart Buildings Business to be based at PUNE, Maharastra.

* Responsible for business development of Low Voltage Switchgear products for Pune and Surrounding Areas.

* Presenting the ABB Extensive portfolio by focusing on conversion of orders through lead management and Opportunity funnel management in SFDC
* Generating the agreed sales leads to supporting the sales funnel which is part of effective sales process
* Establishes and maintains effective customer relationships to understand customer needs, promotes customer understanding of full product offering, and aligns to provide a solution. Ensures positive customer experience throughout the sales process.

**Qualifications for the role:**

* Degree/Diploma in Electrical Engineering from a recognized institution.
* 8–10 years of overall experience in sales, business development, or a related electrical industry role.
* Minimum 6–7 years of relevant experience in Low Voltage (LV) Switchgear sales or business development.
* Solid understanding of LV Switchgear products, applications, customers, and market dynamics.
* Demonstrated experience in business development, customer acquisition, lead generation, and sales growth.
* Experience managing Pune\-based customers and projects in the LV Switchgear segment.
* Solid capability in marketing, customer engagement, value proposition development, communication, and reaching sales goals.

**More about us:**


ABB Smart Buildings enables optimization of energy efficiency, safety, security and comfort for any building type, through new installations or retrofit solutions. The Division offers integrated digital technologies to control HVAC, lighting, shutters, and security, in addition to energy distribution solutions including DIN rail products, enclosures and emergency lighting through to industrial plugs and sockets and conventional wiring accessories, accommodating for single family homes, multiple dwellings, commercial buildings, infrastructure and industrial applications. The Division’s highly innovative technologies and digital solutions serve rising global demand among real estate developers, owners, and investors for smart building technologies that optimize energy distribution and building automation. The scalable solutions aim to deliver significant sustainable and financial benefits, meeting social and environmental demands, while being able to address even the most complex of customers’ carbon reduction strategies.

  

Building a cleaner, smarter future takes all kinds of minds: the curious, the courageous, and the creative. We welcome people from all backgrounds and experiences.

\*\*Location:\*\* Hinjewadi, Pune, Maharashtra

\*\*Job Type:\*\* Full\-Time

\*\*Work Mode:\*\* Work From Office

\#\# About the Role

We are looking for an energetic and confident \*\*Telecaller / Telesales Executive\*\* to join our team in \*\*Hinjewadi, Pune\*\*.

The primary responsibility will be to \*\*make outbound calls, speak with potential customers, understand their requirements, follow up with leads, and convert interested prospects into customers\*\*.

If you are comfortable speaking with people over the phone, have good communication skills, and are target\-oriented, this role is suitable for you.

\#\# Key Responsibilities

\#\#\# Calling \& Lead Generation

\* Make \*\*outbound calls\*\* to prospective customers from the company's lead database.

\* Make approximately \*\*80–120 calls per day\*\*, depending on lead availability.

\* Introduce the company's products/services clearly and professionally.

\* Understand customer requirements and identify potential opportunities.

\* Explain product/service features, pricing, offers, and benefits.

\* Generate interest and qualify leads.

\#\#\# Follow\-Up \& Conversion

\* Follow up with interested customers through \*\*phone calls and WhatsApp\*\*.

\* Maintain regular follow\-ups with leads until conversion or closure.

\* Handle customer questions, objections, and basic concerns.

\* Schedule meetings/demos/callbacks whenever required.

\* Convert qualified leads into customers.

\* Maintain proper records of all calls and follow\-up activities.

\#\#\#

CRM \& Reporting

\* Update every lead and call outcome in the \*\*CRM system\*\*.

\* Maintain accurate information such as:

\* New Lead

\* Connected

\* Not Connected

\* Interested

\* Follow\-up Required

\* Meeting Scheduled

\* Converted

\* Not Interested

\* Maintain daily calling and follow\-up reports.

\* Share daily performance updates with the reporting manager.

\#\# Daily Responsibilities

A typical day may include:

\*\*Morning\*\*

\* Check assigned leads.

\* Review pending follow\-ups.

\* Prioritize high\-potential leads.

\*\*During the Day\*\*

\* Make outbound calls.

\* Speak with prospects.

\* Understand their requirements.

\* Explain the product/service.

\* Handle objections.

\* Schedule meetings or demos.

\* Follow up with previous leads.

\* Update CRM after every interaction.

\*\*End of Day\*\*

\* Complete pending follow\-ups.

\* Update CRM.

\* Prepare daily calling report.

\* Share lead/conversion status with the manager.

\#\# Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)

Performance will be evaluated based on:

\* Number of calls made.

\* Call connection rate.

\* Qualified leads generated.

\* Follow\-ups completed.

\* Meetings/demos scheduled.

\* Leads converted.

\* Revenue generated.

\* CRM data accuracy.

\* Daily attendance and punctuality.

\#\# Requirements

\* Good \*\*Hindi and English communication skills\*\*.

\* Marathi communication will be an added advantage.

\* Comfortable making a high volume of phone calls.

\* Confident and polite while speaking with customers.

\* Basic computer knowledge.

\* Ability to use WhatsApp and CRM software.

\* Good listening and convincing skills.

\* Target\-oriented and self\-motivated.

\* Ability to handle rejection professionally.

\#\#\# Freshers Can Apply

Freshers with good communication skills and a willingness to learn are welcome.

Prior experience in \*\*telecalling, telesales, BPO, inside sales, customer support, lead generation, or business development\*\* will be an advantage.

\#\# What We Offer

\* Fixed monthly salary.

\* Performance\-based incentives.

\* Training and product knowledge sessions.

\* Growth opportunities.

\* Friendly working environment.

\* Opportunity to develop sales and communication skills.

\#\# Ideal Candidate

We are looking for someone who:

\* Enjoys talking to people.

\* Is comfortable making \*\*100\+ calls when required\*\*.

\* Does not hesitate to follow up repeatedly with interested leads.

\* Can confidently explain products/services.

\* Can handle customer objections.

\* Is motivated by targets and incentives.

\* Can maintain disciplined CRM records.

\* Wants to grow in \*\*Sales / Business Development\*\*.

\#\# Working Location \*\*Hinjewadi, Pune, Maharashtra\*\*

title: Value Realization Manager
description:
**Who are we?**


Checkmarx is the leader in application security and ensures that enterprises worldwide can secure their application development from code to cloud. Our consolidated platform and services address the needs of enterprises by improving security and reducing TCO, while simultaneously building trust between AppSec, developers, and CISOs. At Checkmarx, we believe it’s not just about *finding risk but* *remediating* it across the entire application footprint and software supply chain with one seamless process for all relevant stakeholders.


We are honored to serve more than 1,800 customers, which includes 40 percent of all Fortune 100 companies, including Siemens, Airbus, Salesforce, Stellantis, Adidas, Wal\-Mart, and Sanofi.

**About the Role**


We're looking for a \*\*Value Realization Manager\*\* to join our Revenue Operations team. This is a newly created role focused on one clear mission: making sure the GTM technology we've invested in—Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and similar GTM platforms—actually delivers the business outcomes it was purchased for.


You'll sit at the intersection of RevOps, Sales Enablement, and Vendor Management. Rather than just administering tools, you'll own the \*value\* they generate: adoption, ROI, workflow efficiency, and measurable impact on pipeline and revenue. If you've spent time as a customer success manager on the vendor side of GTM tech and are ready to apply that customer success discipline internally, this role is built for you.

 **What You'll Do**

* Own the end\-to\-end value realization strategy for our core GTM tech stack (Clari, Outreach, PG:AI, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator, and call recorder tools such as Kaia or Clari Copilot)
* Define and track adoption metrics, usage benchmarks, and ROI models for each platform; report regularly to RevOps and Sales leadership
* Partner with Sales, Sales Enablement, Business Application, and IT teams to ensure tools are configured, integrated, and used the way they were intended
* Identify underutilized features or workflows and drive targeted enablement to close the gap
* Act as the internal "CSM" for each vendor relationship—running regular business reviews, escalating issues, and holding vendors accountable to their own value promises
* Build and maintain a value realization scorecard/dashboard that ties tool usage to pipeline, forecast accuracy, and rep productivity outcomes
* Lead onboarding and change management for new tool rollouts or major feature releases
* Gather qualitative and quantitative feedback from sales reps and managers to continuously improve stack ROI
* Serve as the primary point of contact for renewal and expansion conversations, providing usage data and value evidence to inform commercial decisions

  

Requirements:
  

* 3\+ years of experience in customer success, revenue operations, sales enablement, or a related GTM function
* Direct hands\-on experience with at least 2 of the following: Call Recorder Tool, Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, LinkedIn Sales Navigator
* Strong communication and presentation skills—comfortable in front of sales reps, frontline managers, and executive leadership alike
* Strong analytical skills—comfortable building dashboards, interpreting usage data, and translating numbers into a business narrative
* Excellent stakeholder management skills; able to influence sales leaders and reps without direct authority

**Strongly Preferred:**

* Prior experience as a \*\*Customer Success Manager at Clari, Outreach, ZoomInfo, or LinkedIn—you know these tools from the vendor side and understand how to extract maximum value from them
* Familiarity with GTM tech stack architecture and how these tools integrate with each other and with Salesforce/HubSpot
